verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. In both, the Meridian logo has shrunk to a tiny mark tucked next to the CTA instead of leading the layout. The supporting copy is squeezed into a narrow 5-line column jammed against the right edge, at an illegible size with an orphan 'summer.'.
